findings.quote: You may use Spatial Dodge once per round.
findings.why: restates the default 1-reaction-per-round rule; rank 7's 'twice per round' already carries the actual override, so the base line is a redundant restatement of a rules default

findings.quote: Heightened (5th)
findings.why: keep: rank 5/7 tiers add qualitatively different riders (DC change + a free-action Flutter Step chain at rank 7), not pure numeric bloat

findings.quote: and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 1}
findings.why: invented content: the 5e original is a plain Con save to maintain concentration with no condition consequence at all; the Stunned 1/Stunned 2 escalation has no basis in the source

findings.quote: it cannot Sustain any magical effect until the start of its next turn.
findings.why: the store carries no Heightened block at all; the original's entire higher-level design ('DC increases by 1 per spell slot level above 5th') was dropped without translation, unlike every other spell in this set which preserves a heighten idiom

findings.quote: (Escape DC equals your spell DC; successfully Escaping shatters the ice and ends the affliction)
findings.replacement: Escape DC equals your spell DC; successfully Escaping shatters the ice and ends the affliction.
findings.why: load-bearing mechanical content (what ends the affliction, and the DC) left parenthesized instead of promoted to plain prose

findings.quote: (the affliction ends if the spell ends, except at stage 3)
findings.replacement: the affliction ends if the spell ends, except at stage 3;
findings.why: a genuine override of the default (affliction normally tracks the spell) buried in parens instead of stated in plain prose

findings.quote: Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained]{Restrained}
findings.why: the original's progression is a repeated Con save each turn (one fail = instant petrification, three non-consecutive successes = spell ends) with the creature still saving even while petrified unless concentration is held the full minute; the store replaces this with a standard PF2e affliction stage-ladder (Escape-based stage 1, automatic stage 2→3 progression) that drops the original's asymmetric save-to-freeze/save-to-escape design entirely

findings.quote: flash-freezing its body from the outside in
findings.why: invented flavor clause with no counterpart in the original, which only says the caster 'manifests the brutal cold of the Grey Waste in a creature you touch'

findings.quote: Heightened (+1)
findings.why: keep: pure flat +1d8 increment idiom, correctly collapsed (original had no heightening at all, this is the needed addition done right)

findings.quote: the brutal cold of the Grey Waste
findings.why: Grey Waste (of Hades) is a named D&D cosmology plane; appears plainly and should be obfuscated, e.g. <Grey Waste|the Ashen Wastes>

findings.quote: (a free action as part of Sustaining)
findings.why: borderline worked-example parenthetical; could be promoted to plain prose ('...at the start of each of your turns as a free action when you Sustain the spell')

findings.quote: The area within 30 feet of the orb counts as difficult terrain for any creature moving away from the orb.
findings.why: the original has a two-tier escalating movement cost (4 feet per 1 foot within 10 feet; 2 feet per 1 foot within 30 feet); the store flattens this into a single uniform 'difficult terrain' rule for the whole 30-foot zone, losing the harsher near-field tier

findings.quote: Small or smaller unsecured nonmagical objects within 5 feet of the orb are automatically destroyed at the end of each of your turns.
findings.why: the original has TWO separate object rules: all unsecured objects in the area are pulled into the orb, AND small nonmagical objects within 5 feet are destroyed; the store keeps only the destruction rule and drops the 'objects are pulled into the orb' mechanic entirely

findings.quote: Heightened (+1)
findings.why: keep: pure flat +1d10 increment idiom, correctly collapsed (original had no heightening, needed PF2e addition done right)

findings.quote: Laixa's insight sharpens your mind to an uncanny acuity, allowing you to pierce deceptions with preternatural certainty.
findings.why: wholly invented flavor sentence; the 5e original is a single terse mechanical sentence with no comparable introductory flavor at all

findings.quote: In addition, while this spell is active you cannot be magically compelled or enchanted into believing false information you have already consciously identified as false during the duration.
findings.why: this entire clause is invented — the original is one sentence granting only the Insight-check replacement; this whole immunity mechanic has no basis in the source

findings.quote: New deceptions presented after you cast the spell that you have not examined are not automatically rejected, however.
findings.why: self-evident scope restatement (of course unexamined new lies aren't covered); teaches the obvious edge case

findings.quote: Heightened (6th)
findings.why: keep: adds new skill-check scope (Diplomacy, Deception) rather than pure numeric bloat

findings.quote: Allies in the emanation gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls.
findings.why: original grants allies a bonus to BOTH attack rolls and saving throws (automatic, no save); store drops the saving-throw bonus for allies entirely, keeping only the attack-roll bonus

findings.quote: must attempt a Will save; resolve the save separately for each enemy, and once an enemy has rolled, it doesn't roll again from this casting.
findings.why: original imposes an automatic (no-save) penalty to both attack rolls and saving throws on every enemy in the aura; store converts this into a resistible Will save that, on a mere failure, only penalizes attack rolls (saves are only penalized on critical failure) and allows full resistance/temporary immunity — a substantial restructuring beyond vocabulary translation

findings.quote: resolve the save separately for each enemy
findings.why: self-evident from 'each enemy...must attempt a Will save' — restates that each creature rolls its own save

findings.quote:
Heightened (6th) The status bonus and penalty both increase to +2 / -2.

Heightened (9th) Both increase to +3 / -3.
findings.replacement: Heightened (+3) The status bonus and penalty each increase by 1.
findings.why: bespoke two-tier block is actually a pure numeric ladder (+1/-1 every 3 ranks) — matches the struck 'flat check DC increases by 2' exemplar exactly and should collapse to a flat (+N) idiom

findings.quote:
You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC.
- You gain resistance 15 to physical damage.
findings.replacement: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and resistance 15 to physical damage,
findings.why: wholly invented mechanics — the 5e original grants only the d6 magic-deflection ability, no AC bonus and no damage resistance of any kind; also formatted as a dashed bullet list rather than prose

findings.quote: Frequency: once per round.
findings.why: possibly redundant with the default 1-reaction-per-round economy (as with flutterstep's 'once per round' line), though stat-block Frequency fields are also common official idiom — flagging for judgment

findings.quote: A ranged spell attack roll targets you, a line spell would pass through your space, or you would be targeted by a spell that requires a ranged attack roll
findings.why: original explicitly names magic missile (an auto-hit spell requiring no attack roll) as a trigger alongside line spells and ranged-attack spells; the store's trigger requires an attack roll throughout, silently dropping coverage for auto-hit force-type spells

findings.quote: Each creature in the emanation, including you, takes 6d6 void damage and 6d6 bludgeoning damage from the spatial shockwave.
findings.replacement: Each creature in the emanation, including you, must attempt a basic Reflex save against 6d6 void damage and 6d6 bludgeoning damage from the spatial shockwave.
findings.why: the original explicitly calls for a Dexterity saving throw; the store's body never states which save applies anywhere in the text (every sibling spell in this sample states its save type inline)

findings.quote: Each chosen creature improves the degree of success of its saving throw against this spell by one step.
findings.why: original guarantees chosen creatures automatically succeed (full immunity); store only guarantees a one-step improvement, which can still leave a weak roll at mere 'success' (half damage) rather than immunity

findings.quote: Heightened (+1)
findings.why: keep: pure flat +1d6/+1d6 increment idiom, correctly collapsed

findings.quote: (including the attacker)
findings.why: load-bearing scope clarification (whether the triggering attacker also takes the damage) left parenthesized instead of promoted to plain prose

findings.quote: The number of charges increases to 6.
findings.why: wholly invented tier — the original's only higher-level rule is a flat 1d6 damage increase per slot above 2nd; there is no charge-cap growth in the source

findings.quote: The number of charges increases to 6.
findings.why: matches the struck exemplar pattern of tiers that merely loosen a cap/limit — suspect bloat candidate on top of having no basis in the original (see T6)

findings.quote: On the round you cast this spell and each round you Sustain it, the target must attempt a Will saving throw against 8d6 damage of the relived type.
findings.why: original has a two-tier design: 6d6 on the initial cast vs a weaker 4d6 on each bonus-action repeat; the store flattens both into one uniform 8d6 applied every round

findings.quote: Each round's save is rolled separately.
findings.why: self-evident restatement of 'each round...must attempt a Will saving throw'

findings.quote: Heightened (+1)
findings.why: keep: pure flat +2d6 increment idiom, correctly collapsed

findings.quote: A failing creature also has its highest-rank currently prepared, spontaneous, or innate spell slot suppressed rather than consumed.
findings.why: original mechanic is a PERMANENT loss of the creature's highest-level spell slot; store softens this to a temporary suppression that recovers by the end of the creature's next turn (per the Failure line) — a substantial severity change, not just vocabulary translation

findings.quote: Heightened (+1)
findings.why: keep: matches the original's own flat per-rank scaling idiom (already expressed as scaled dice in the source)

findings.quote: This affects all dice rolls that occur entirely within the emanation: attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throw rolls.
findings.replacement: This affects all dice rolls that occur entirely within the emanation: skill checks, attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throw rolls.
findings.why: original's affected-category list explicitly includes ability checks; the store's enumerated list omits any check category entirely

findings.quote: It does not affect flat checks.
findings.why: redundant with the preceding closed enumerated list (attack/damage/saving throw rolls only) which already excludes flat checks by omission — pre-answers an edge case the list already resolves

findings.quote:
Heightened (8th) The emanation expands to 60 feet.

Heightened (10th) The emanation expands to 120 feet.
findings.why: fixed two-tier block is a pure doubling ladder on a regular +2-rank cadence — matches the struck 'flat check DC increases by 2' exemplar pattern and should collapse to a flat (+N) idiom

findings.quote: If the current carrier ends their turn still holding the charge, the Transfer Count increases by 3.
findings.why: original also forces an immediate detonation roll against the holder at that moment ('roll as if it was transferred to you'); the store only raises future odds, dropping the immediate self-check

findings.quote: you glow softly, visibly suffused with unstable force
findings.why: original says 'glowing brightly'; store both reverses the intensity and adds ornamentation not present in the source

findings.quote: Heightened (+2)
findings.why: keep: pure flat increment idiom (+1d8 fire/+1d8 mental), correctly collapsed

findings.quote: cannot be targeted by any effect, cannot be detected, cannot observe or interact with the world, and are not affected by anything that happens in your absence
findings.why: original states only two protections (unaffected by events during the interval, unaware of them); store expands this into four enumerated clauses, including new claims (untargetable, undetectable) absent from the source — list-ification plus invented scope

findings.quote: skipping ahead by one tick of the clock
findings.why: minor invented flavor turn of phrase; the original just says you disappear and reappear, with no 'tick of the clock' framing

findings.quote: (the creature must be adjacent to you when you cast the spell and reappears adjacent to you)
findings.replacement: if the creature is adjacent to you when you cast the spell, it reappears adjacent to you
findings.why: load-bearing placement rule for the heightened ally-transport rider left parenthesized instead of promoted to plain prose

findings.quote: Heightened (4th)
findings.why: keep: both rank-4 and rank-6 tiers add qualitatively different riders (turn-skip choice; ally transport + range) rather than pure numeric bloat
